trailhead.label: Car park at Pöc dali Fafc above Caderzone Terme, the APT’s start

cautions: Mountain paths with a climb to a 2,175 m pass.
Cattle on the pastures of Malga San Giuliano and Malga Campostril in summer.
Long day: six hours, little shelter on the pass.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
